local contacts = {}
local function add(name, phone)
    assert(type(name) == "string" and name ~= "", "name required")
    contacts[name] = { name = name, phone = phone }
end
local function search(name) return contacts[name] end
local function edit(name, phone)
    local contact = contacts[name]
    if not contact then return false end
    contact.phone = phone; return true
end
local function delete(name) contacts[name] = nil end
add("Mina", "555-0100")
edit("Mina", "555-0101")
print(search("Mina").phone)
delete("Mina")
